references.name: Designer action figure package
references.use_for: Personal-brand reveals, team spotlights, creator launches, collectible product concepts
references.prompt_frame: Transform the supplied adult subject, mascot, or product character into a premium molded collectible inside clear retail blister packaging. Preserve the recognizable face, hair, proportions, outfit cues, and brand colors. Arrange two or three meaningful accessories in separate fitted compartments. Use straight-on commercial toy photography, realistic plastic reflections, crisp softbox lighting, controlled shadows, and a package silhouette that reads immediately on mobile. Keep packaging geometry clean; omit small copy unless exact wording is supplied. No accidental logos, duplicate accessories, malformed hands, or watermark.

references.name: Candid instant-film portrait
references.use_for: Friendship, reunion, creator, fashion, and behind-the-scenes posts
references.prompt_frame: Create one candid instant-film snapshot using the supplied adult subject reference or references. Preserve each identity and the natural relationship between subjects. Use a thick asymmetric white instant-film border, hard on-camera flash, slightly overexposed foreground, warm faded color shift, fine grain, soft focus, and background falloff into shadow. Frame it like a spontaneous memory with a slightly imperfect crop and believable hand placement. Keep the environment simple and lived-in. No celebrity insertion unless explicitly supplied, no duplicate faces, no synthetic glamour retouching, and no watermark.

references.name: Multi-era yearbook grid
references.use_for: Nostalgia carousels, identity-led hooks, team and creator series
references.prompt_frame: Create a clean 2x2 yearbook portrait grid showing the same supplied adult identity across four selected eras. Lock facial structure, skin tone, eye color, and recognizable features in every panel. Change only period-appropriate hair, grooming, wardrobe, mottled studio backdrop, lens softness, and print color response. Use a consistent chest-up pose and authentic school-photo key lighting. Keep each era distinct without parody. No school names, fake signatures, unreadable captions, identity drift, or watermark.

references.name: 1980s cinematic time travel
references.use_for: Fashion, music, location, heritage, and personal-brand stories
references.prompt_frame: Place the supplied adult subject into a clearly named year and location. Preserve identity and body proportions while adapting wardrobe, hair, props, architecture, vehicles, practical lighting, lens character, film stock, and color response to that period. Integrate light and shadow across the subject and environment so the image feels photographed there, not composited. Use one decisive cinematic moment and a social-safe crop. Avoid era-mixing, modern objects, fake brand marks, unreadable signage, anatomy drift, and watermark.

references.name: Imperfect disposable-camera memory
references.use_for: Authentic creator posts, friendship memories, fashion recaps, and event photos
references.prompt_frame: Turn the supplied adult subject or group into a late-1990s or early-2000s disposable-camera memory. Preserve identity while using off-center framing, one intentional edge crop, dusty film grain, tiny scratches, uneven exposure, mild red-eye where plausible, a single corner light leak, and slight movement blur. Mix available light with direct flash and keep expressions candid. The result should feel found in a photo envelope, not professionally art-directed. Avoid heavy beauty retouching, staged symmetry, duplicated limbs, fake logos, and watermark.

references.name: Tactile scrapbook travel journal
references.use_for: Travel, fashion recap, relationship, product story, and carousel covers
references.prompt_frame: Build one tactile scrapbook journal page from the supplied subject, product, or campaign references. Use one dominant photograph and two or three supporting moments with consistent identity and product details. Layer torn paper, instant-photo borders, tape, ticket-like shapes, pressed botanicals, stamps, and restrained handwritten-mark textures with realistic paper depth and shadows. Keep the page readable at mobile size and leave a clean area for optional captioning. Do not invent readable handwriting, real ticket data, logos, duplicate faces, or watermark.

references.name: Faux prestige thriller poster

references.name: Kinetic city motion-blur fashion still

Use realistic panning physics, integrated practical light, grounded feet or believable object contact, and a strong path through the frame. Do not blur the identity or product, duplicate limbs, float the subject, add logos, or add a watermark.

references.name: Y2K record-store camcorder frame

Capture a specific candid activity rather than a posed portrait. Leave room where a timestamp could sit but do not render one unless exact text is supplied. references.name: Empire State maintenance catwalk selfie
references.use_for: Viral identity-transfer selfie at a forbidden or aspirational location — looks like a real leaked photo
references.prompt_frame: iPhone front-camera selfie. Use the reference images only to preserve identity — facial features, hairstyle, body proportions. Do not copy clothing from references; dress subject(s) in casual street clothing appropriate for a cold windy day at height. Two people are taking a spontaneous selfie from the Empire State Building's narrow outdoor maintenance catwalk — the kind that wraps the building's upper spire, not the public observation deck. No other tourists or bystanders visible anywhere. One person holds the phone naturally at arm's length using the front camera; both subjects lean slightly toward each other and the camera, looking at the screen not the lens, relaxed expressions as if capturing a quick memory rather than posing. The Manhattan skyline is visible far below in the background, the catwalk railing or steel structure visible at the edge of frame. Authentic iPhone front-camera physics: 24–26mm equivalent ultra-wide lens, visible barrel distortion at frame edges, outstretched arm visible, natural hand position, imperfect framing, slight horizon tilt, casual crop, subtle finger shadow near one corner. Subtle HDR processing, slightly over-sharpened smartphone detail, realistic skin texture with visible pores and small imperfections, wind-affected hair and clothing wrinkles, harsh daylight with slightly lifted shadows, faint lens smudging, minimal digital noise, natural color science. Photorealistic, candid, not professional, not cinematic, not influencer-style — a believable snapshot that looks like it was posted straight from the camera roll.

references.name: GTA VI loading screen portrait
references.use_for: Transform a reference photo into official-quality GTA VI loading screen commercial art with Vice City palette
references.prompt_frame: Transform the uploaded reference photo into a high-end commercial illustration inspired by the promotional loading screen artwork of Grand Theft Auto VI and Grand Theft Auto: Vice City. Preserve the exact identity, pose, facial features, clothing, accessories, hairstyle, camera angle, and overall composition of the original photo — do not alter the person. Reimagine the existing background rather than replacing it: keep the original location immediately recognizable by preserving its layout, perspective, architecture, streets, natural features, landmarks, and overall atmosphere. Reinterpret the environment as if it exists naturally within the world of GTA VI's Vice City — enhance it with richer visual storytelling, more stylized architecture, cinematic lighting, refined environmental details, vibrant colors, subtle signage, atmospheric depth, and immersive world-building while respecting the purpose and character of the original location. Add vehicles, pedestrians, storefronts, vegetation, palm trees, street furniture, neon lighting, luxury details, or urban activity only where they naturally belong. If the original scene is residential, rural, industrial, mountainous, indoors, or otherwise quiet and unsuited to traffic or crowds, do not introduce unnecessary cars, palm trees, pedestrians, or city elements — every environmental addition must feel like a believable evolution of the original scene, not a replacement. Illustrate using the iconic GTA VI commercial art style: photorealistic base with subtle stylization, vibrant cinematic color grading, deep contrast, warm Vice City palette (sunset oranges, hot pinks, ocean teals, deep purples), heightened detail on clothing and accessories, slight painterly texture in shadow regions, cinematic rim lighting on the figure. The result should feel like official Rockstar Games promotional key art — a loading screen poster, not fan art.

groups.name: Automotive Photography
groups.bulk_use: Full retouch and grade of supplied car photographs — five stylized looks, each sharing the same complete editing stack with a distinct final aesthetic

references.name: Showroom Clean retouch
references.use_for: Dealer brochures, manufacturer press shots, product launch imagery, neutral hero shots
references.prompt_frame: Perform a full editorial retouch on this car photograph as a professional automotive retoucher. Exposure and color: correct white balance to neutral, set accurate exposure, recover highlight detail in the paint, and lift shadow detail without flattening contrast. Paint and panels: remove reflections of the photographer, light stands, and surrounding clutter from the body panels while preserving natural environment reflections that define the car's shape; smooth panels to clean gradients; eliminate dust, water spots, and minor scratches. Detail pass: clean brake dust from wheel barrels, deepen tire black, clarify headlight and taillight lenses, and polish chrome and brightwork. Scene cleanup: remove trash, cones, poles, stray vehicles, and people from the background without altering the location; repair pavement blemishes under and around the car. Final grade — Showroom Clean: neutral whites, accurate paint color, crisp micro-contrast, zero color cast, low grain — the result should look like manufacturer press photography. Preserve the original car exactly: same body shape, proportions, wheels, badges, paint color, license plate, camera angle, focal length, composition, and crop. Do not add, remove, move, or reshape any object. This is a retouch of the supplied photo, not a new image.

references.name: Golden Hour Warm retouch
references.use_for: Lifestyle automotive content, social media, natural light shots, aspirational car posts
references.prompt_frame: Perform a full editorial retouch on this car photograph as a professional automotive retoucher. Exposure and color: correct white balance and exposure, recover highlight detail in the paint, and lift shadow detail without flattening contrast. Paint and panels: remove reflections of the photographer, light stands, and surrounding clutter from the body panels while preserving natural environment reflections that define the car's shape; smooth panels to clean gradients; eliminate dust, water spots, and minor scratches. Detail pass: clean brake dust from wheel barrels, deepen tire black, clarify headlight and taillight lenses, and polish chrome and brightwork. Scene cleanup: remove trash, cones, poles, stray vehicles, and people from the background without altering the location; repair pavement blemishes under and around the car. Final grade — Golden Hour Warm: push highlights toward amber-orange, introduce a soft magenta bias in the shadows, add gentle bloom on specular reflections, lift midtones slightly, and warm the overall color temperature as if the last 30 minutes of sunlight are hitting the car — even if the original was shot in flat light. Preserve the original car exactly: same body shape, proportions, wheels, badges, paint color, license plate, camera angle, focal length, composition, and crop. Do not add, remove, move, or reshape any object. This is a retouch of the supplied photo, not a new image.

Preserve the original car exactly: same body shape, proportions, wheels, badges, paint color, license plate, camera angle, focal length, composition, and crop. references.name: Night Urban retouch
references.use_for: Night car photography, urban automotive content, city shoot edits, neon-lit environments
references.prompt_frame: Perform a full editorial retouch on this car photograph as a professional automotive retoucher. Exposure and color: correct white balance and exposure, recover highlight detail in the paint, and lift shadow detail without flattening contrast. Paint and panels: remove reflections of the photographer, light stands, and surrounding clutter from the body panels while preserving and enhancing the neon and artificial light reflections that are naturally present in the scene; smooth panels to clean gradients; eliminate dust and minor scratches. Detail pass: clean brake dust from wheel barrels, deepen tire black, clarify headlight and taillight lenses, polish chrome and brightwork, and enhance practical light sources already in the scene. Scene cleanup: remove distracting background elements without altering the urban location; repair pavement blemishes. Final grade — Night Urban: lift blacks slightly into a cool lifted base, separate cool shadows from warm highlights (where warm practical lights exist), apply controlled bloom on streetlights, signs, and headlights that are already in the frame, and preserve the color of neon and artificial sources already reflected in the paint. The result should feel cinematic and premium without adding light sources that were not there. Preserve the original car exactly: same body shape, proportions, wheels, badges, paint color, license plate, camera angle, focal length, composition, and crop. Do not add, remove, move, or reshape any object. This is a retouch of the supplied photo, not a new image.
